title: Ride along at Daytona International Speedway
description: Climb into a NASCAR-style stock car as a passenger and let a professional driver take you around Daytona’s banked oval. The grandstands and infield flash past at a scale television cannot convey. The ride is brief, so notice the banking, engine noise, and force of each turn while you are there.
teaser: Feel Daytona’s banking from inside a race car.
goodToKnow: The ride involves window entry, acceleration, vibration and strong G-forces. Ask the operator about participation requirements; confirm current dates and prices.
whyItMightDelightYou: It turns a familiar televised sport into a physical memory of speed, sound, and sweeping corners.
